message.content: A highly regarded documentary on global warming is **“An Inconvenient Truth”** (2006). It follows former U.S. Vice‑President Al Gore as he presents scientific evidence on climate change and its impacts, and it sparked widespread public discussion about global warming. If you’re looking for something more recent, you might also enjoy **“Before the Flood”** (2016) featuring Leonardo DiCaprio, which explores the causes and consequences of climate change and potential solutions.
